basic_info.description: Introducing 1083 Clay, a stunning condominium in the heart of San Francisco's coveted Nob Hill neighborhood. This exceptional residence boasts a desirable layout perfect for entertaining, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows offering captivating views, a modern kitchen with quartz countertops, a spacious dining area, a luxurious primary bedroom, separate home office space, an incredible common roof deck, and 1 car parking. Experience the rich history and vibrant lifestyle of Nob Hill, with easy access to dining, shopping, entertainment, and outdoor activities. Property is not currently staged, photos are from prior staging.
